title: Cancer stage at diagnosis by duration of pre-existing chronic analgesic use and anxiety or depression
core_idea: Examine whether the type and duration (recent-onset vs persistent/historic) of common chronic conditions—specifically anxiety/depression and chronic analgesic medication use—are associated with cancer stage at diagnosis for lung and colorectal cancers, using linked national cancer registry and primary care data and multivariable logistic regression.
tldr: Study aims to assess associations between duration/type of pre-existing anxiety/depression and chronic analgesic use (recent-onset vs persistent) and stage at diagnosis for lung and colorectal cancers using linked registry and primary care records, considering potential mechanisms such as differential healthcare utilisation and competing demands.
